title: Job Interview in English
ringkas: Pertanyaan umum, memperkenalkan diri, kelebihan dan kekurangan, serta alasan melamar
goals: memperkenalkan diri dalam **wawancara kerja** (Tell me about yourself)
menjawab pertanyaan **kelebihan, kekurangan, dan alasan melamar**

lesson.text: Wawancara dalam bahasa Inggris menuntut jawaban yang **jelas, singkat, dan terstruktur**. Pewawancara menilai isi jawaban dan juga kepercayaan dirimu. Unit ini melatih pertanyaan yang paling sering muncul.

lesson.title: 1. Pertanyaan yang paling sering
table: [[I'm a ... with ... years of experience in ...]]
[[I sometimes ..., but I'm working on it by ...]]
[[Where do you see yourself in five years?]]
[[I have ..., and I can help by ...]]

lesson.title: 2. Ungkapan yang berguna
table: [[Thank you for having me.]] / [[It's a pleasure to meet you.]]
[[That's a good question. Let me think for a moment.]]

lesson.title: 3. Pertanyaan untuk pewawancara
table: [[What does a typical day look like in this role?]]
[[Could you tell me about the team?]]
[[What are the next steps in the process?]]

lesson.title: Hindari jawaban terlalu pendek atau terlalu panjang
lesson.text: Jawab dalam 30–60 detik, 3–5 kalimat. Jangan menjawab hanya *Yes* atau *No*, dan jangan membacakan seluruh CV.

lesson.title: Latihan yang efektif
lesson.text: Rekam jawabanmu untuk 'Tell me about yourself' dan dengarkan. Perhatikan kelancaran, tempo, dan apakah ada contoh nyata.

items: Tell me about yourself: profesi + pengalaman + tujuan.
Selalu siapkan satu atau dua pertanyaan untuk pewawancara.

practice.q: Jawaban terbaik untuk "Tell me about yourself" dimulai dengan...
options: ringkasan profesional singkat
riwayat hidup lengkap sejak lahir sampai sekarang
keluhan tentang pekerjaan dan atasan lama
jawaban yang sangat singkat tanpa penjelasan

practice.q: Pilih jawaban "Why do you want this job?" yang paling baik:
options: I am interested in this role because it matches my skills in customer service.
I need money to pay my bills, so any company will do for me.
My friend told me to apply, so I sent my resume to your office.
I do not really know the job, but I think it is easy work.

practice.q: Pilih jawaban "What are your strengths?" yang paling baik:
options: I am good at organising my work. For example, I finished my last project two days early.
I am the best person you will ever meet, and I never make mistakes.
I do not have any strengths, but I try to come to work every day.
I like sleeping and watching films, so I stay relaxed at work.

practice.q: Pilih jawaban "What is your weakness?" yang paling baik:
options: I sometimes spend too long on details, but I now set time limits for each task.
I have no weaknesses at all, and I never have any problems at work.
I hate working with other people, so I prefer to stay alone all day.
I am always late to work, but I think it is not a big problem.

practice.q: Pilih jawaban "Where do you see yourself in five years?" yang paling baik:
options: I hope to grow into a senior role and help train new staff.
I will be on a beach, and I will not work anymore by then.
I will have your job, so you should be careful from now on.
I do not plan my future, because anything can happen to me.

practice.q: Pilih jawaban "Why should we hire you?" yang paling baik:
options: I have three years of experience, and I can help your team improve customer satisfaction.
I need a job right now, so please give me a chance to work.
I am a good person, and my family says that I am very kind.
Why not hire me? I think there is no reason to refuse me.

practice.q: Ungkapan yang sopan untuk meminta pengulangan pertanyaan:
options: Could you repeat the question, please?
What? I did not hear anything that you said to me.
Say it again, because the room is very noisy today.
I did not understand, so please ask me a different one.
practice.exp: Jawaban yang tepat: **Could you repeat the question, please?**

practice.q: Ungkapan untuk memberi waktu berpikir:
options: That's a good question. Let me think for a moment.
Uh, uh, uh, I really do not know what I should say now.
I refuse to answer this question, so please go to the next one.
Please ask me later, because I am too tired to answer you.

practice.q: Pada awal wawancara, ucapan yang tepat:
options: Thank you for having me.
Let's finish quickly.
I'm in a hurry.
Where is my desk?
practice.exp: Jawaban yang tepat: **Thank you for having me.**

practice.q: Ungkapan "I have worked as ... for ... years" digunakan untuk...
options: menjelaskan pengalaman kerja
menolak pekerjaan
meminta gaji
menutup wawancara
practice.exp: Pengalaman. Jawaban yang tepat: **menjelaskan pengalaman kerja**.

practice.q: Ungkapan "I'm skilled in ..." digunakan untuk...
options: menyebut kemampuan
meminta maaf
menolak tugas
mengubah topik

practice.q: Pertanyaan yang baik diajukan kepada pewawancara:
options: What does a typical day look like in this role?
How much money will I get, and when can I get my first salary?
Can I leave early on Fridays and come late on Mondays?
Do I have to work with other people in this company?

practice.q: Pertanyaan yang baik diajukan kepada pewawancara:
options: What are the next steps in the process?
Do you like me, and will I get a better offer from you?
Can I go home now, because I have another meeting soon?
Why is the office so small, and where is the coffee machine?

practice.q: Berapa panjang jawaban yang ideal?
options: sekitar 30 sampai 60 detik
sekitar 5 detik
sekitar 10 menit
tidak ada batas

practice.q: Kesalahan umum saat wawancara:
options: menjawab hanya Yes atau No
memberi contoh nyata
bertanya kepada pewawancara
berpakaian rapi

practice.q: Pilih kalimat yang paling profesional:
options: I am looking for a role where I can use my skills and keep learning.
I want any job that pays me money, and I do not care what it is.
I just need a salary, so the work itself does not matter to me.
I do not mind what I do, because every job is the same for me.
practice.exp: Profesional. Jawaban yang tepat: **I am looking for a role where I can use my skills and keep learning.**

practice.q: Thank you for ___ me.

practice.id: Aku pernah bekerja sebagai kasir selama dua tahun.
practice.q: I have ___ as a cashier for two years.
I'm ___ in customer service.
Could you ___ the question, please?
Good morning. Please tell me about yourself.
turns: Good morning. Please tell me about yourself.
answers: I'm a customer service officer with three years of experience. I enjoy helping people and solving problems.
I have worked as an accountant for four years, and I'm looking for a new challenge.
I'm a recent graduate in business and I'm eager to learn.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: I'm a customer service officer with three years of experience. I enjoy helping people and solving problems.  atau  I have worked as an accountant for four years, and I'm looking for a new challenge.  atau  I'm a recent graduate in business and I'm eager to learn.

practice.q: Why do you want to work for our company?
turns: Why do you want to work for our company?
answers: I admire your company's reputation, and this role matches my skills.
I'm interested in this role because I can use my experience and keep learning.
I like your products and I want to grow with your team.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: I admire your company's reputation, and this role matches my skills.  atau  I'm interested in this role because I can use my experience and keep learning.  atau  I like your products and I want to grow with your team.

practice.q: What are your strengths?
answers: I'm good at organising my work. For example, I always meet deadlines.
I work well in a team. For example, I helped my team finish a project early.
I'm a fast learner. In my last job, I learned a new system in a week.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: I'm good at organising my work. For example, I always meet deadlines.  atau  I work well in a team. For example, I helped my team finish a project early.  atau  I'm a fast learner. In my last job, I learned a new system in a week.

practice.q: What is your biggest weakness?
answers: I sometimes spend too much time on details, but I'm learning to set time limits.
I used to be shy, but now I practise speaking in meetings.
I find it hard to say no, so I'm learning to prioritise my tasks.
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: I sometimes spend too much time on details, but I'm learning to set time limits.  atau  I used to be shy, but now I practise speaking in meetings.  atau  I find it hard to say no, so I'm learning to prioritise my tasks.

practice.q: Do you have any questions for us?
turns: Do you have any questions for us?
answers: Yes, what are the next steps in the process?
Yes. What does a typical day look like in this role?
Yes, could you tell me about the team?
practice.exp: Contoh balasan: Yes, what are the next steps in the process?  atau  Yes. What does a typical day look like in this role?  atau  Yes, could you tell me about the team?

options: berfokus pada profesi dan pengalaman
berisi keluhan
sangat panjang
berisi rahasia
menyebut kelemahan dan usaha memperbaiki
mengatakan bahwa kamu tidak punya kelemahan sama sekali
menyalahkan atasan lama atas semua masalahmu
diam saja sampai pewawancara berhenti bertanya

quiz.q: Kalimat yang tepat saat tidak mendengar pertanyaan:
options: Could you repeat that, please?
What? I could not hear any word from you.
Huh? Say it again because it was very unclear.
Please say it again quickly; I am in a hurry now.
quiz.exp: Jawaban yang tepat: **Could you repeat that, please?**

quiz.q: Pertanyaan yang tepat di akhir wawancara:
options: What are the next steps?
When can I leave, because I am quite tired now?
Is the job easy, and do I have to work hard?
Do you pay a lot of money to your new staff?
quiz.exp: Profesional. Jawaban yang tepat: **What are the next steps?**

options: sekitar 30 sampai 60 detik
sekitar 5 detik
sekitar 5 menit
tidak ada batas

quiz.q: Ungkapan "I have worked as ..." memakai tense...
options: present perfect
future
past continuous
present simple saja
I am eager to contribute to your team.
I just want money, and I will take any work at all.
I do not mind what happens, because it is all the same.
Whatever happens, I will see what happens next week.
quiz.exp: Profesional. Jawaban yang tepat: **I am eager to contribute to your team.**

quiz.q: Pilih jawaban "Why should we hire you?" yang paling baik:
options: I have relevant experience and I learn quickly.
I am a good person and my friends say that I am funny.
I need a job right now, so please hire me quickly.
Why not hire me? There is no good reason to refuse.
